full_judgment: "When the legislature enacts a "deeming" clause, the correct way to interpret the same is to find out for what purpose and upto what extent the legal fiction has been created. It is the function of the Court to find out the limitation of the legal fiction, to delimit its boundaries and not to extend the frontier of legal fiction beyond what has been provided in the statute."
